name: Oomiya Mariko
source:
An office worker who assists Rikako.

She is a  soft and fluffy type of girl, who carries her paperwork between her boobs.

Her tea and soft smile are an oasis for male employees.

She gets work pushed on her a lot by Rikako. she's a shrewd and capable girl who can handle the increase in her duties.

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/soft.phtml?id=719516]getchu[/url]]
